name: kg_create_state_node
description: Create a new State (or Event) node + an edge from owner → state in one transaction. Both rows are written to kg_revision_log under one revision_log_id so the create is reversed by deleting the new edge + the new node. Use for residence-eras, job-eras, event participations, etc. that the extractor missed but the operator now wants modeled. Refuses node_type outside {State, Event}; for new Entity nodes go through the regular ingest path.

inputs.name: owner_node_id
inputs.description: Existing entity that 'owns' this state (source of the new edge).

inputs.name: predicate
inputs.description: relationship_type for the owner→state edge, e.g. 'has_residence'.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Label for the new node, e.g. 'Scottsdale, Arizona residence'.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why this state should exist. Into kg_revision_log.

outputs.description: One-line summary of what was created (or would be).
{ok, revision_log_id, new_node_id, new_edge_id} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before, after} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_create_state_node:
- owner_node_id (required): the entity that owns the state
- predicate (required): edge relationship_type, e.g. 'has_residence'
- label (required): new node label
- node_type (optional): 'State' (default) or 'Event'
- category, description, original_sentence (optional)
- start_date, end_date (optional, ISO dates)
- start_date_confidence, end_date_confidence (optional)
- sentence (optional): sentence on the owner→state edge
- attributes (optional): extra JSON attrs
- reason (required): why; goes into kg_revision_log
- dry_run (optional): preview only
- finding_id (optional): source finding id
